description: World Bank Service Delivery Indicators is published by World Bank. Service Delivery Indicators are facility surveys measuring health and education service quality, including provider knowledge and service readiness. Its stated coverage is Participating countries; nationally representative facility surveys. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider page describes access through its website or linked resources; the underlying files or applications were not downloaded or run. The inspected public resource is free to access. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. Survey years and participating countries vary; this is not a complete global facility inventory. For simulation, it can inform health-service demand, capacity and disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
